description: National vehicle-importer action began January 11; local El Tejar closure on January 12 does not close all ports and border phases. Local start time conflicts by one hour.
required_followup: Reconstruct each connected physical phase and leadership; reconcile ownership without adding automatic city or day episodes.

description: Earlier November and December campaign links exist; continuous physical episodes and relationship among January 14 capital, Petapa and Xela actions remain unresolved.
required_followup: Compare adjoining months and actual assembly boundaries before merging or counting local candidates.

description: All candidate physical closure dates remain unknown except the two Alta Verapaz junction blockades reported ended January 11.
required_followup: Locate explicit physical dispersal, departure or closure reports; do not substitute last publication, work resumption, route endpoint or month end.

description: The Quetzaltenango petition and announced weekend demonstration do not establish executed public assembly dates. Ilotenango’s described gathering lacks a physical date.
required_followup: Verify actual gatherings and dates; preserve null starts until evidence supports occurrence and month ownership.

description: Most specific state responses are unknown. Historical repression, murders motivating protest, suspect arrests, ordinary patrols and generic policy promises are not linked responses.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous conduct toward each gathering. Count any actual operational dispersal attempt, regardless of success, and actual formal dialogue or reception when linked.

description: The AGN port meeting concerns cargo-processing agents; connection to the vehicle-importer blockade leadership is not explicit.
required_followup: Identify participants and demands at the actual meeting before transferring accommodation to the importer action.

description: Ilotenango participants dispute who organized the fair-permission demonstration. The mayor claims reception; the transport union reports refusing participation.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous local reporting or meeting records to verify the gathering date, organizers and formal reception.

description: TVN and Plaza Pública share EFE text for January 24. Archive and canonical Sololá pages also share one underlying account. Traffic sources relay Provial or Telediario.
required_followup: Treat these as common-origin sources and seek an additional independent account.

description: Many discovery URL cards remain search_only; unopened articles, mixed indexes and later-year search noise are not evidence. Page 925 returned a redirect loop; page 941 and the Sololá canonical article were recovered.
required_followup: Prioritize relevant unopened original reporting and preserve access outcomes without bypassing actual denials.

description: Research used Spanish and English indexed web material. Indigenous-language radio, local oral reporting and unindexed rural coverage were not systematically searched. Coverage across 22 departments is uneven.
required_followup: Search accessible regional and Indigenous-language archives with appropriate language support; record documentary reach instead of claiming complete coverage.

description: Open-web searches and weekly date strings do not reproduce LexisNexis or establish weekly archive coverage. Search operators returned unrelated years and places. No official original baseline reconciliation was completed.
required_followup: Keep the baseline gate pending; compare the authorized official universe, schema and use conditions before integration.

description: Two initial queries were executed before assignment; exact times were not captured and only ten relevant initial URLs were reconstructed. Later query calls preserve pooled URL results, without per-query allocation or result totals.
required_followup: Retain null exact timestamps and the honest observed checkpoint; do not invent full initial discovery coverage or per-query result counts.

description: Read times were not captured individually. Source accessed_at now records the later observed checkpoint; discovery timestamps are preserved separately. Hivos publication date and Radio Zapatista actual title remain unverified.
required_followup: Recover metadata only from actual pages and keep discovery, read checkpoint, publication and physical event dates distinct.
